messages:
Alex: Taking over oncall from 21:00 PT tonight. Quick preflight — can folks confirm:
- VPN creds work
- Pager access (PagerDuty) is active
- Runbook for model-serving incidents is linked in case of perf regressions
- API keys for nonprod infra (for smoke tests)
I'll run through checks in ~30m.

Mira: I can help. VPN tested 15m ago, SSH via jump.redwood.ai ok. :white_check_mark:

Sam: PagerDuty: you're already in rotation, I added you to 'infra-oncall' schedule. You should get a test page in 2m. Ping if not.

ops-bot: PagerDuty test page sent to Alex — status: delivered.

Alex: Received, got the page. Also do we have access to encryption keys for private deploys? KMS access? Need to rotate tokens later.

Priya: You have iam:Decrypt on prod-kms?no — Wait, for private deployments keys are restricted. I granted Alex temporary 'kms-decrypt' role for tonight (expires in 12h). Check AWS console -> IAM Roles -> session 'alex-oncall-rot'.

Jordan: Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/model-serving — TL;DR: for high latency, restart model pool, fallback plan: swap to cpu-serve, scale down batchers. Steps 2 and 3 are partially automated.

Mira: Quick smoke command for nonprod:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api-np.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $NP_KEY' -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq '.tokens'
```
— expecting 200 and tokens>5. I ran it, output OK.

Alex: Thanks. Two notes: (1) If VPN drops, use `ssh -J bastion@jump.redwood.ai alex@dedicated-node` (2) Pager escalation contact is Sam -> Priya -> Eng SRE if >30m. I'll leave final oncall handoff note in #eng-oncall at 20:50.

Sam: Added quick checklist to runbook: creds, smoke, pager, logs dashboard link. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Saved snapshot of current Grafana dashboard (https://grafana.redwood/d/abc) at 1992345679.

Jordan: One risk FYI: overnight batch jobs scheduled to start at 02:00 — could cause transient CPU spike on ded pool. I've moved them to 03:00 after talking to infra.

Alex: Noted. I'll monitor from 21:00-23:00. Thanks all — reassigning oncall to me at 21:00. :rocket:
